newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads - Underperform versus bloc.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads - Underperform versus bloc.

text.p: Australian bonds underperformed against the dollar bloc as jitters over the U.S. retail sales report later on Tuesday filtered through to the local market.
The figures are expected to show a modest rebound after three consecutive monthly falls, although analysts said revisions to previous months will also be heavily scrutinised.

Adding to the local market's weaker tone were comments by Workplace Relations Minister Peter Reith that some demands for wage increases would push wages growth above the Reserve Bank's targets and would not be good for interest rates.
Yield spreads to the bloc are now more or less back to levels seen prior to last week's weaker-than-expected employment report, which had sparked renewed thoughts of a monetary policy easing.
However, analysts are confident that the spread compression to the U.S. can resume if next week's second quarter inflation proves as benign as expected.
